_comment: DealerDesk 98 — RPA Minefield Configuration. The desktop app reads chaos toggles from the chaos_settings table (Settings panel); this file documents difficulty presets and RPA use cases.

random_dialog.description: Pops 'DMS server connection lost' dialog (loops on Cancel)

session_timeout.description: Shows session expired, optionally logs out

critical_error.description: Massive red ERROR popup with fake stack trace

field_corruption.description: Appends garbage chars to focused field

save_failure.description: Error dialog but write is silently dropped

bsod_overlay.description: Full-screen fake Blue Screen of Death

login.title: Login Flow
login.description: Enter credentials and land on the dashboard
login.validation: A user row matches the credentials and the dashboard window is shown

customer_search.title: Customer Search & Lookup
customer_search.description: Search by name or customer number and open a record
customer_search.validation: Customer detail window opens with the correct customer number

repair_order_entry.title: Repair Order Entry (PRIMARY — Service)
repair_order_entry.description: The primary service RPA flow: open a customer, write up a repair order with the 3 C's, and save
steps: Click name=btn_ro_lookup_customer, search and Select a customer
Click name=btn_ro_lookup_vehicle, Select the customer's vehicle
Type date into name=ro_date, choose name=ro_type / name=ro_advisor / name=ro_status, type name=ro_mileage
repair_order_entry.validation: A new row exists in repair_orders with the entered concern/cause/correction

deal_entry.title: Deal Entry (PRIMARY — Sales)
deal_entry.description: Create a sales deal linking a customer to an in-stock vehicle
steps: Click name=btn_deal_lookup_vehicle, Select an in-stock vehicle
Fill name=deal_date / name=deal_salesperson / name=deal_type / name=deal_sale_price / name=deal_status
deal_entry.validation: A new row exists in deals; if status is Sold/Delivered the vehicle status becomes 'Sold'

appointment_schedule.title: Appointment Scheduling
appointment_schedule.description: Schedule a service or sales appointment for a customer
appointment_schedule.validation: A new appointments row exists with status Scheduled

inventory_lookup.title: Inventory Lookup
inventory_lookup.description: Search the lot for a vehicle by stock number, VIN, or make/model
inventory_lookup.validation: Matching vehicles are displayed in the inventory grid

report_generation.title: Report Generation
report_generation.description: Run a canned dealership report and read the output
report_generation.validation: The report renders rows in the output notebook

end_to_end.title: End-to-End Service Visit
end_to_end.description: login -> find customer -> open record -> create repair order -> schedule follow-up -> logout
end_to_end.validation: Repair order and appointment rows persist; session ends
